comment: Known expected state of verification commands (tempdoc 680, environment lane). Consumed by the known-state-hint hook (PreToolUse Bash): when a command matches an entry's `match` regexes, the claim is surfaced so sessions stop re-deriving 'is this failure mine?' via stash-and-verify. DISCIPLINE: every pin carries an exit — an `exitProbe` (a command; exit 0 means the pinned state is GONE, checked by observations-triage --probe, report-only) or a `reviewBy` date after which the pin must be re-affirmed or removed. A pin without a fired exit is edited only by a human. `slow:` prefix on exitProbe = only checked with --slow.
